wealth.label: Wealth
wealth.description: An introductory reading on managing resources, opportunities, and building up what you have.

study.label: Study
study.description: A basic themed reading about study methods, focus, and steady practice.

romance.label: Romance
romance.description: A basic reading on communication, getting along, and nurturing relationships.

木.title: Firm Roots, New Branches
木.text: When roots are firmly established, branches and leaves have room to spread. This wealth reading focuses on building and exploring: the skills, experience, and resources you already have can be a starting point for a new direction. Watch for scattered efforts. When you have several plans, clarify your priorities so that each step has a firm footing.
木.advice: List three skills or resources you already have. Choose one near-term goal and break it into manageable steps.

火.title: Balanced Enthusiasm, Purposeful Action
火.text: Here, the image of Fire represents enthusiasm and expression. This wealth reading emphasizes turning new ideas into clear plans. When considering an invitation to collaborate or trying something new, make the goal clear and understand the time and energy it will take. Give your enthusiasm a way to become action, while leaving a little calm space for decisions.
火.advice: Choose one project you want to move forward. Write down its goal, the resources it needs, and what completion will look like, then plan the first step.

土.title: Steady Habits, Growing Stores
土.text: Here, the image of Earth represents stability and accumulation. This wealth reading focuses on everyday arrangements: first understand how you use your resources, then look for small improvements you can sustain. Stability still allows for change. Leave room to adjust within your existing routine, making space for both long-term goals and immediate needs.
土.advice: Review your spending over the past week and sort it into three groups: necessities, things you enjoy, and items you could adjust.

金.title: Choose Clearly, Leave Room
金.text: Here, the image of Metal represents standards and choices. This wealth reading emphasizes clear boundaries. When considering prices, special offers, or other people's advice, first establish what you truly need, then compare your options. Clear criteria can reduce indecision and help you devote your time, energy, and resources to what matters more to you.
金.advice: Write down three essential conditions for an upcoming purchase or collaboration, then compare each option against them.

水.title: Stay Flexible, Check the Source
水.text: Here, the image of Water represents flexibility and information. This wealth reading focuses on judgment amid change. New information can offer ideas, and it can also disrupt your existing rhythm. Check its source first, then consider how it relates to your current goals. Leave room to adjust when changing direction, so that change serves your plan instead of pulling it along.
水.advice: Choose one piece of information that has recently influenced a decision. Find its original source and note one question that still needs to be checked.

木.title: Let Your Goals Take Shape
木.text: Think of learning as tending a seedling: a clear direction matters more than sending out many branches at once. When approaching something new, choose one small goal and break it down into an exercise you can finish today. Allow your pace to vary, and notice change through the steps you complete instead of constantly comparing yourself with others.
木.advice: Choose one learning goal today, write down a small task you can finish in twenty minutes, and complete it.

火.title: Bring Understanding to Light
火.text: Enthusiasm can get you started with learning and give you a reason to share what you know. When a topic interests you, explain it in your own words and notice where your explanation flows and where it becomes unclear. A pause can be a clue to something worth checking in the source material; there is no need to rush toward a polished explanation.
火.advice: After learning a concept, close your materials, explain it in your own words for one minute, and then check what you left out.

土.title: Let Past Learning Take Root
土.text: Knowledge often builds when you encounter familiar material again. Studying something once does not mean you know it well, and something you cannot recall yet can point you toward useful review. Instead of taking on a large amount at once, revisit a few key points. Separate what you remember from what you need to look up, giving your next review a clear focus.
土.advice: Choose three key points from yesterday's learning, write them down from memory, and then use your materials to fill in the gaps.

金.title: Give Knowledge a Clear Framework
金.text: Organize knowledge as you would a set of tools: begin by clarifying what each concept is for and where its limits lie. When reviewing a question you answered incorrectly, record more than the correct answer. Identify a misread condition, a missed step, or a confused concept. Locating the specific mistake makes it easier to plan your next practice than simply calling yourself careless.
金.advice: Choose one question you answered incorrectly, write down the exact step where you went wrong, and then solve it again on your own.

水.title: Follow Questions, Find Connections
水.text: When facing unfamiliar material, first ask what question it addresses and how it connects with what you already know. Rather than quickly skipping over something unclear, try another example or draw the connections, then check them against the original material. Writing down a specific question gives your search for information a direction and helps you avoid drifting from one piece of information to another.
水.advice: Write down one question you do not yet understand, explain it through a familiar everyday example, and then check the limits of that example.

木.title: Give a New Connection Room to Grow
木.text: Getting to know someone is like tending a new shoot: give each other space and notice whether conversation continues naturally. You can take the initiative through a shared interest or a casual invitation, gradually learning about each other's interests and habits. Both people shape the pace of a relationship. Feeling relaxed, comfortable, and willing to keep talking are all feelings worth noticing.
木.advice: Offer a casual invitation to someone who is open to talking, and respect their choice to accept, decline, or leave it unanswered for now.

火.title: Warmth at a Pace That Suits You Both
火.text: Enthusiasm brings warmth to a conversation and helps sincere feelings come through. You can express your appreciation clearly while giving the other person time to respond. Take turns sharing and listening: talk about your feelings and pay attention to the other person's comfort, so you can both communicate at a pace that feels natural.
火.advice: Express one specific thing you appreciate, then notice whether the other person wants to continue the conversation.

土.title: Care with Warmth and Boundaries
土.text: Care can take the form of following through on one small promise. A steady relationship needs both people to feel comfortable: willing to care for each other and able to state their own limits. Keep help freely given, and make room for rest and time alone. Everyday details can express warmth while leaving each person space to look after their own life.
土.advice: Before making a promise, check your time and energy, then explain clearly what you can do.

金.title: Bring Your Expectations into an Honest Conversation
金.text: An honest conversation can make each person's expectations clearer. Talk about what matters to you in a relationship, and listen fully to the other person's needs. When you disagree, first understand the differences, then discuss arrangements you can both accept. Respect each other's choices and leave room to adjust the pace and closeness of the relationship.
金.advice: Choose a calm moment to discuss one everyday habit you value in a relationship, and ask what the other person thinks.

水.title: Listen First to Understand the Relationship
水.text: Communication is like flowing water: pay attention to the direction a conversation takes. When a response is unclear, separate what the other person actually said from your own assumptions, then gently check your understanding. Listen carefully to each other's needs, allow some questions to remain unanswered for now, and leave room for honest, natural conversation.
水.advice: During a conversation, sum up what you heard in one sentence and ask the other person whether you understood correctly.

element_readings.木: Wood has one of the highest surface counts: the reading focuses on growth and planning, with steady accumulation as the wealth theme.
element_readings.火: Fire has one of the highest surface counts: the reading focuses on energy and expression, with opportunity and moderation as the wealth themes.
element_readings.土: Earth has one of the highest surface counts: the reading focuses on patience and stability, with long-term accumulation as the wealth theme.
element_readings.金: Metal has one of the highest surface counts: the reading focuses on order and decision-making, with planning and management as the wealth themes.
element_readings.水: Water has one of the highest surface counts: the reading focuses on flexibility and reflection, with movement and change as the wealth themes.

wealth.title: A Steady Stream
wealth.text:
A slender stream winds round blue-grey stone;
Slow steps reveal the path that brought you here.
wealth.interpretation: This lot focuses on everyday accumulation. First understand your recurring income and expenses, then set your own pace. Nurture small habits you can sustain, let your near-term plans work with the rhythm of your life, and notice small adjustments that are easy to overlook.
wealth.advice: Make a list of your recurring expenses and mark those that are essential, those you could adjust, and those you no longer need.

wealth.title: Clarity by Lamplight
wealth.text:
By lamplight, trace the path;
Let the heart settle before you step.
wealth.interpretation: This lot draws attention to checking the details before deciding. When considering a discount, an invitation, or a fresh idea, give yourself a little time to understand its practical use, the resources it requires, and any conditions involved. Clear reasons can help you plan the next step and keep your choices close to what truly matters to you now.
wealth.advice: When considering an unplanned expense, write down its practical use before deciding whether to buy.

wealth.title: Old Things Shine Again
wealth.text:
Brush away the dust, and old things reappear;
Leave an open space to welcome a fresh breeze.
wealth.interpretation: This lot invites you to take another look at the possessions, time, and skills you already have. Take stock of resources you can continue using before buying more or taking on new commitments. Keep your plans grounded in your present circumstances while leaving suitable room for new ideas.
wealth.advice: Tidy a corner you use often and find one item you can keep using or repair.

study.title: One Step, One Page
study.text: New words upon a page, small steps across a bridge.
study.interpretation: This lot is about starting small. When a whole chapter feels like a lot to take on, choose one concept or one question and give yourself a chance to work through it. Record the specific difficulty you encounter during practice so you have a clear starting point next time.
study.advice: Choose a question of moderate difficulty, work on it for fifteen focused minutes, and note the exact step where you get stuck.

study.title: Old Pages, New Insights
study.text: By lamplight, old pages turn; rereading brings new insights.
study.interpretation: This lot draws your attention to review and correction. Knowledge you have temporarily forgotten and questions you once answered incorrectly can both guide your revision. Distinguish an unclear concept from an overlooked condition or a mistaken step, then plan a practice exercise that addresses it.
study.advice: Choose a past question you answered incorrectly, cover the answer and solve it again, then compare your work with the explanation and write one correction note.

study.title: A Clear Voice, a Question
study.text: One clear voice among the pages, one question sprouting a new branch.
study.interpretation: This lot is about explaining and asking questions. Putting knowledge into words can reveal both what you understand clearly and what remains uncertain. When you cannot explain a part, return to your materials to check it. You can also ask someone to point out anything in your explanation they did not understand.
study.advice: Choose a concept you have just learned, record a one-minute explanation, then listen back and note one point you need to check.

romance.title: A Path in the Spring Breeze
romance.text: Leave a narrow path beside the flowers; let a greeting pass like a gentle breeze.
romance.interpretation: This lot is about getting to know someone with ease. Start with a shared topic and notice whether you both want to keep talking. Focus on the responses and feelings you experience together in the moment, letting the relationship develop at a pace that feels comfortable for both of you.
romance.advice: When you both feel like talking, share a topic you have in common and give the other person room to end the conversation naturally.

romance.title: Listen Quietly to the Heart
romance.text: Clear spring water mirrors scattered shadows; in stillness, hear a true voice.
romance.interpretation: This lot focuses on listening and checking your understanding. Distinguish what the other person has said from your own assumptions. Express your true feelings and give them a chance to clarify. Through specific conversations, gradually learn what matters to each of you.
romance.advice: In your next conversation, first sum up the other person's meaning in one sentence. Check that you have understood before sharing your own feelings.

romance.title: Room for the Breeze
romance.text: Between branches side by side, leave a little space; let every leaf welcome the breeze.
romance.interpretation: This lot is about making room within closeness. Take care of your own daily rhythm and respect the other person's plans. Calmly explain anything that needs to be discussed, making room for both time together and time alone.
romance.advice: Set aside some time alone today and turn your attention to one small thing you enjoy doing.

lots.title: Steady Progress
lots.text: Do one thing in front of you well, then take another step forward.

lots.title: Organize Your Thoughts
lots.text: Clarify your goals and priorities so you can act with greater ease.

lots.title: Patient Accumulation
lots.text: Stay patient and value every small step of progress.
